description: Données Ouvertes sur les Bornes Fontaines - Hydraulique Villageoise au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Les bornes fontaines - hydraulique villageoise sont des infrastructures essentielles permettant l’accès à l’eau potable dans les zones rurales et semi-rurales du Togo. Ces données recensent les bornes fontaines mises en place dans le cadre des systèmes d’hydraulique villageoise, qui jouent un rôle crucial dans l’amélioration des conditions de vie des populations en milieu rural. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Its tags are bornes, fontaine, hydraulique, village. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
